idea-plugin.name: Colibri Code
idea-plugin.description:
Adds Colibri to JetBrains Air as a local agent, backed by a model running on this machine.

There is no Colibri tool window: pick Colibri in Air's agent menu. The plugin installs a managed ACP bridge and keeps ~/.jetbrains/acp.json pointing at it. The engine starts on the first prompt, not when Air opens, and stops after it has been idle, so an open IDE costs no model memory. An engine that was already running is attached to and left alone.
